text:
Maya Lin: quick sync on the token-ingest postmortem actions. want owners and an exact runbook for credits + ledger patches. aiming to close remediation this sprint.
Omar Wallace: summary from my side: missing tokens came from a downstream dequeue delay between 2024-04-02 03:00 and 03:45 UTC. plan = (A) deterministic backfill, (B) canonical reconcile file, (C) invoice adjustments + customer comms, (D) follow-up monitoring rules. i can own (A) and (D).
Jun Park: will own (B) and the ledger patch mapping. i need the backfill job id and the record-level provenance fields so the CSV can be auditted. please include original_event_id, source_bucket, and processing_stage in the output.
Hannah Li: i'll draft the customer-facing note and the internal finance memo. for customer-facing, preference is a short explanation + credit amount + how it shows on next invoice. internal memo should include cost impact and rollback plan. i'll need final credit counts by 16:00 PST.
billing-bot: remediation ticket RED-2024-099 opened. owners: Omar (backfill+monitoring), Jun (reconcile+ledger), Hannah (comms), Maya (program owner). target_close: 2581117200. status: triaged.
Omar Wallace: backfill plan: run small pilot on a 5k account sample at 22:00 UTC tonight. full-job params:
```
job_name=backfill-2024-04-dequeue
start_ts=2024-04-02T03:00:00Z
end_ts=2024-04-02T03:45:00Z
workers=8
consistency=strong
```
Omar Wallace: pilot to validate idempotency and de-dup keys; full run ~3.5h based on pilot.
Jun Park: CSV schema requested: account_id, invoice_id, token_delta, original_event_ts, backfill_job_id, original_event_id, commit_flag, overlapping_invoice_window, audit_hash. please add a final column "action_suggested" with values [auto_credit, manual_review, ignore].
Hannah Li: crediting policy proposal: auto_credit if token_delta >= 500 OR token_delta >= 5% of monthly usage; manual_review for 50-499; ignore under 50. exceptions: accounts with committed_units=true should be reviewed and not auto-credited.
Maya Lin: good. add one more rule: if overlapping_invoice_window=true and token_delta > 0 then manual_review regardless of size. avoids double adjustments.
Jun Park: will flag commit_flag and overlapping_invoice_window in CSV. need a query to detect committed accounts; Omar can you annotate events with customer_billing_tier at ingest time?
Omar Wallace: yep can add customer_billing_tier tag. will surface commit_flag from billing service join.
ops-oncall-bot: note: backfill run may increase write RPS on ledger DB. suggest running during 02:00-05:00 UTC maintenance window.
Maya Lin: schedule pilot 22:00 UTC tonight, full run 02:00 UTC tomorrow if pilot green. Jun, Hannah, can you confirm you'll have artifacts within 6 hours of full run completion?
Jun Park: yes — reconciliation CSV and audit manifest within 4 hours of job completion.
Hannah Li: can do comms draft within 4 hours. finance sign-off needed after Jun posts costs.
billing-bot: RED-2024-099 updated: pilot_scheduled=2581108800, full_run_est=2581116000, postrun_deadline=2581119600. link: https://redwood.internal/remediations/RED-2024-099
Omar Wallace: QA checks to run after backfill: (1) total tokens delta matches expected requeued volume, (2) sample accounts show idempotent outputs, (3) no invoice duplication in ledger. will post logs and samplings here.
Jun Park: i'll run a reconciliation diff tool: diff_tool --left=pre_ingest_ledger --right=post_backfill_ledger --out=rediff-RED-2024-099.csv ; will also include per-invoice hashes for integrity.
Hannah Li: communications plan: phase 1 auto-email for auto_credit recipients, phase 2 outreach by CS for manual_review accounts. include an appeal link.
Maya Lin: escalation plan: if cost delta > $50k pause auto-credit and route to finance exec for sign-off. Sachin (not in thread) will need to be looped.
Jun Park: noted. i'll include a cost_estimate column in the artifact so finance can quickly sum.
Maya Lin: final ask: please post short status updates here as you complete each milestone. i'll run a 17:00 sync if things spill. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
